run_compiler_gym_loop_opt_service: run the CompilerGym loop optimization service as a gRPC server for RL agents
create_loops_opt_compilation_session: create a LoopsOptCompilationSession instance to apply loop unroll or vectorize actions to a benchmark
apply_loop_optimization_action: apply a loop unroll or vectorize action to LLVM IR via the apply_action method
get_loop_opt_observation: get an observation like IR, Inst2vec, Autophase, Programl, runtime, or size from a session
review_loops_opt_service: review the LoopsOptCompilationSession class and its loop unroll and vectorize action spaces
